Alex K.: heads-up handoff — ongoing incident affecting text-gen hosted in eu-west-1, GC/KV cache eviction spikes causing tail latency and ~5-10% increase in 5xxs for premium routing. paging was triggered at 2024-04-11T02:13Z by oncall-bot. primary: alex (me). secondary: mira.
oncall-bot: ALERT: kv-cache-eviction-rate > 800/min on eu-west-1 (rule: kv.eviction.rate.high). Pager duty: paged @alex @mira.
Mira S.: taking secondary for the next shift. current summary pls?
Alex K.: short: eviction storm on memtier nodes after recent prefetch config change. Affected service: text-gen-hosted (route: premium-eu). Customers: small number of high-QPS accounts saw increased latency and occasional failures.
Jamal P.: seeing similar in prod-logs: repeated OOMs in memtier-3 leading to process restarts. snippet from logs: ```[2024-04-11T02:05:12Z] memtier-3 evict key=usr:cache:prefetch id=0x4af3 size=12MB```.
Sophie L.: any customer-facing impact? Are SLOs breached?
Alex K.: we hit tail-latency SLO for 95th p50? (typo) — 95th crossed 300ms for a 12-min window. Revenue-impacting routes slightly degraded. CS notified for top 3 customers, they've seen transient errors.
Mira S.: mitigations applied so far: 1) rolled back the prefetch flag on memtier nodes (cfg: prefetch.enabled=false) 2) started graceful drain of memtier-3 group 3) scaled up dedicated pool with +4 nodes (manual scale). Observed drop in eviction rate but still seeing noise.
deploy-bot: deploy 172.22.45.18 -> memtier-3 rollback completed (job #4521).
Alex K.: remaining risk: transient cold-cache storms while drains finish, and one memtier node repeatedly restarting due to OOM (investigating memory leak in prefetch code path). Plan for next hour: continue drains, monitor eviction rate <50/min, hold new prefetch experiments, and prepare fallbacks.
Jamal P.: suggestion: enable fallback-routing for premium-eu to use cached model-variant (model: gpt-medium-quant) to reduce pressure on tokenization path. Command to flip: ```curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' https://console.redwood/api/routing/flip -d '{"route":"premium-eu","fallback":"quant-gpt-medium","percent":100}'```
Mira S.: doing the fallback flip now, will watch for errors.
(oncall-bot): ACTION: routing change initiated by Mira S. — rolling to 100% fallback for premium-eu.
Alex K.: quick runbook links: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/kv-evictions and https://internal.playbooks/incidents/eviction-mitigation. Key steps in runbook: check eviction counters, drain node, patch prefetch toggle, add mem limit guard, route fallback.
Sophie L.: night coverage question — I need to step out at 22:00 UTC, who's covering after Mira?
Mira S.: jamal will cover overnight primary from 22:15 UTC to 06:15 UTC. there's a 15-min overlap to transfer.
Jamal P.: noted. is there any outstanding manual action I should be prepared to run?
Alex K.: outstanding: 1) run heap-dump on memtier-3 if restarts continue: ```kubectl exec -n infra memtier-3-0 -- /usr/local/bin/heap-dump /tmp/heap-$(date +%s).dump``` then upload to s3://redwood-dumps/evictions/ 2) if eviction rate > 200/min after fallback, run emergency scale: ```rctl capacity allocate --pool memtier --count 6``` (ops ACL required).
Mira S.: added these to the incident checklist and pinned them in the channel.
Sophie L.: coverage gap: we don't have a dedicated infra-oncall tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. recommend oncall rotation overlap or paging the infra-ops alias if node restarts continue.
Alex K.: agreed — I've notified infra-ops via email and created a ticket: https://tickets.redwood/INC-2026-eviction. if infra can't assign, jamal please escalate to ops at 02:05 UTC.
Jamal P.: will do. Also I'll watch query-per-second and 95th-latency dashboards and promote to SEV if customer impact widens.
oncall-bot: NOTE: next automated health-check in 5m.
Mira S.: primary handoff notes for jamal: checkpoints = eviction-rate, memtier restarts, premium-eu 5xx rate, route fallback status. playbook section v2 link: https://internal.playbooks/incidents/eviction-mitigation#v2.
Alex K.: leaving detailed steps here so you can pick up: 1) confirm routing flip stable (no >1% error delta) 2) keep drains running until memtier group healthy 3) collect heap-dump if restarts persist, upload and ping eng-ml 4) if fallback doesn't reduce load within 10m, run emergency scale and notify CS.
Sophie L.: thx all. I'll update CS with the current mitigation status and ETA for handoff. cc @mira @jamal :thumbsup:
Alex K.: I'm off now, handing to Mira and Jamal for overnight. ping me if escalation needed. :v:
Mira S.: ack — taking over. Jamal will be primary from 22:15 UTC. I'll keep watching until 23:00 then switch to async monitoring.
Jamal P.: ack. I'll update this thread at handoff complete and again on any state changes.
(oncall-bot): THREAD CLOSED FOR NOW — no pageable alerts for 10m. (auto-note)
